methods.name: IMMDA (Unsupervised cross-domain landslide extraction framework)
methods.summary: An unsupervised cross-domain landslide extraction framework that integrates an image mask module and a morphological information extraction and optimization module. It uses a dual-model (teacher-student) architecture where the student model is trained on masked target domain images to learn contextual information, while morphological pseudo-labels guide the learning of landslide shapes.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes an unsupervised cross-domain landslide extraction framework that integrates image mask and morphological information enhancement... The proposed framework comprises two core modules: (1) an image mask module and (2) a morphological information extraction and optimization module.
